label: Fresh modern
ornament: Round corners on a crisp hero photo with a small pill caption, no frame
image_style: Bright, tidy rooms and surfaces with a cool, crisp grade: daylight from a window, clean lines, one task finished. No people facing the camera.
voice: Clear and upbeat. Lead with the result, then what is included, in plain words. Short headings that name the job; no slang, no exclamation marks.

label: Calm daylight
ornament: White pill captions on photos, a small dot before every eyebrow
image_style: Empty, sunlit interiors in soft morning light, the left side of the frame left plain for copy; one prop (a plant, a towel, a vase) in the brand hue. No people, no clutter.
voice: Calm and reassuring. Short sentences about rooms, light and time given back. Nothing urgent, no exclamation marks, no claims the facts do not make.

label: Warm editorial
ornament: An eight-spoked mark before every eyebrow, a hairline arch behind the hero
image_style: One person mid-task, seen from behind or at a distance, in warm daylight; linen, wood, plants and natural textures. Never a face presented as staff.
voice: Warm and editorial, like a small studio's journal. Concrete nouns, one idea a sentence, the headline's last phrase carried by the italic face.

label: Bright local
ornament: A hand-drawn underline in the accent under the headline's last word
image_style: Lively, lived-in rooms and local streets in saturated daylight: colourful but tidy, a real sense of the neighbourhood. No faces presented as staff or customers.
voice: Friendly and local, like a neighbour you trust. Name the town, talk about the week, keep it light; contractions are fine, jokes are not.

label: Counsel
ornament: A short rule before every eyebrow, numerals 01, 02, 03 on lists and steps
image_style: Desks, documents, bookshelves and building exteriors in cool, neutral light; hands and papers at most. Never a client's face, never a courtroom or a gavel.
voice: Measured and plain-spoken. Say what happens and when, in the words a client would use; no jargon where a plain word works, no promise about an outcome.

label: Quiet luxury
ornament: Thin rules: a hairline before every eyebrow and above every section heading
image_style: Still life and architecture in low, directional light: stone, glass, leather and brushed metal, long shadows, few objects. No people.
voice: Understated and exact. Few words, no superlatives, the confidence of not having to say much. One short sentence where another site would use three.

label: After dark
ornament: Wide tracking on eyebrows, navigation and buttons, a hairline before eyebrows
image_style: Night and golden-hour vehicle and venue details: chrome, leather, reflections on wet streets, city lights out of focus. No faces, no number plates.
voice: An unhurried concierge. Short, assured sentences about timing, discretion and the evening ahead; never gushing, never a rate the facts do not give.

label: Bold young
image_style: High contrast and tight crops: a hand, a tool, a surface, in strong light and deep shadow with one bold colour. Never a posed smile.
voice: Direct and confident. Short lines, active verbs, a little wit, never a joke at the customer's expense. Say the thing, then stop.
